policies.required: missing value makes the snapshot non-publishable
policies.optional: missing value receives the fixed neutral contribution; weight is not redistributed
policies.confidence_only: never changes ranking score and may only reduce confidence
policies.duplicate: a feature code may occur at most once in a score definition
policies.temporal: all observations and releases must be available no later than snapshot_at
forbidden: predicted prices without a separate versioned model
